svg.title: Shell risk index by altitude
svg.desc: Relative collision-rate index per 25 km band, log scale, for two catalogs. Numbers are in shell_risk.csv.
svg.text: Shell risk index per 25 km band (100 = riskiest band in each catalog)
Log scale; values below 0.001 sit on the floor. A relative index from public data, not a collision probability. Data: CelesTrak; Space-Track.org (USSPACECOM).
